keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «큰 먼지 폭풍이 온다(문제)» 와 «레오가 무사하고 화성에 간 첫 사람이 된다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a big dust storm comes) and the ending (Leo is safe and is the first person on Mars). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.qko: 레오는 왜 아무것도 볼 수 없나요?
opts: He closes his eyes to sleep.
He drives into a dark cave.
evs: Suddenly, a big dust storm comes!
Leo drives a rover over the rocks.
He gets inside just in time.
why: «Suddenly, a big dust storm comes!» 큰 먼지 폭풍이 불어와서 앞이 보이지 않아요.
A big dust storm comes, so Leo cannot see anything.

qs.q: "He follows the beep, beep of his base." What is "beep, beep"?
qs.qko: «He follows the beep, beep of his base.» 에서 «beep, beep» 은 무엇일까요?
opts: a sound that helps Leo find the way
evs: Mars is red and dusty, and it is very cold.
Leo is safe, and he is the first person on Mars!
why: «Leo cannot see anything.» 레오는 앞이 안 보여서 «삐, 삐» 소리를 듣고 따라가요. «beep, beep» 은 기지로 가는 길을 알려 주는 소리예요.
Leo cannot see anything, so he follows a sound with his ears. "Beep, beep" is a sound that shows him the way to his base.

qs.q: How does Leo get safe from the storm?
opts: He follows the beep of his base and gets inside.
He drives his rover very fast to Earth.
He hides under a big red rock.
evs: He follows the beep, beep of his base.
He gets inside just in time.
Leo drives a rover over the rocks.
why: 기지의 «삐, 삐» 소리를 따라가서(«He follows the beep, beep of his base.»), 아슬아슬하게 안으로 들어가요(«He gets inside just in time.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
He follows the beep, beep of his base, and he gets inside just in time. You need both sentences.

ends: Leo finds water under the red rocks of Mars.
레오가 화성의 붉은 바위 밑에서 물을 찾는다.
Leo flies back to Earth, and everyone cheers for him.
레오가 지구로 돌아오고, 모두가 그를 환영한다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)

img.cover: On red, rocky Mars, a young man with short brown hair in a white space suit with orange stripes and a clear round helmet hurries toward a round white dome base with a blinking green light as a huge swirling wall of red dust rolls in behind him, and the green light on the base blinks to guide him home.

scenes.1: On red, rocky Mars, a young man with short brown hair in a white space suit with orange stripes and a clear round helmet drives a six-wheeled silver rover over the rocks as a giant cloud of swirling red dust rushes toward him and fills the sky.
scenes.2: At the open door of a round white dome base with a blinking green light, a young man with short brown hair in a white space suit with orange stripes and a clear round helmet jumps inside just in time and gives a happy thumbs up, while the red dust storm swirls behind him.
